purpose.zh: 练手臂高位时的肩袖控制
purpose.en: Train rotator cuff control with the arm raised.

text.zh: 上臂与肩同高、肘成90°，前臂转到竖直
text.en: Upper arm at shoulder height, elbow at 90 degrees, rotate the forearm up to vertical

text.zh: 肩胛下沉后收，躯干不动
text.en: Keep your shoulder blade down and back and your trunk still.

text.zh: 顶端稍停，再慢慢转回前方
text.en: Pause at the top, then rotate back down slowly.

commonErrors.zh: 重量太重，用耸肩或后仰拉上去
commonErrors.en: Using too much weight and shrugging or leaning back to pull it up.

cautions.zh: 选很轻的重量，出现肩前部疼痛立即停止
cautions.en: Use a very light weight and stop right away if the front of your shoulder hurts.
